verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is an LLM inference engine with a CLI, an HTTP server and a web UI. The evidence pack shows no feature for defining automations, scheduled jobs or autonomous background tasks. Running `llama serve` as a long-lived server, or deploying via Docker, is host-level operation, not an automation capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
